newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end higher but bid fails to fire market.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end higher but bid fails to fire market.

text.p: Renewed takeover interest in the regional electricity companies provided much of the interest on Monday in an otherwise subdued start to the week in London, traders said.

A 630p per share bid from the U.S. by CalEnergy unit, CE Electric for Northern Electric took many in the market by surprise and helped lift prices across the board first thing. However, shares failed to make much headway and a lack of news on other fronts left them drifting for much of the session.
The FTSE 100 ended the day just 2.9 points higher at 4,025.3, with gainers leading losers 55 to 38.
